summary: Every image a provider gets is at most 2000 px on its long side (MAX_IMAGE_LONG_SIDE), the Claude API limit for requests with more than 20 images. Clients resize to it first; the backend shrinks any larger PNG or JPEG before the adapter (older phone builds, re-sends of stored images) and refuses a larger GIF or WebP by name. The desktop composer takes the image type from the extension when the MIME type is missing and converts HEIC/HEIF to JPEG with macOS sips.

storageDataMigration.reason: Stored messages keep the images as the client sent them; only the copy passed to the adapter is shrunk. The turn hash still covers the sent images, so a retry of an accepted turn stays a duplicate. No schema change.

updateRelease.reason: Ships with the next desktop, headless server, Expo OTA and Android release on their usual lanes. jpeg-js and pngjs are pure JS: bundled into the headless server and installed as desktop dependencies, no native rebuild.
